reference_note: Feature reference: every member-year in the training years. Score reference: holdout members in the training years, because scores on rows the model trained on run high.
score_note: Score drift is measured on the uncalibrated probability. The calibrated probability has ties, which makes quantile bins unstable.
label_lag_note: Labels for an index year are complete only 12 months later, so a live monitor sees inputs drift about a year before it can see accuracy drop. In this table the latest year is marked as not mature: its outcomes are in the data because the data is retrospective, but on the scoring date they would not exist yet.
